coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2)
record.summary: A six-story board-formed concrete warehouse of 1941-44 (256 ft by 77 ft, 98,804 sq ft) north of Building 12, one of the historic buildings addressed in the Pier 70 DDA; unlike Buildings 12 and 21, it is an option parcel that must be developed under a 99-year lease consistent with the Secretary of the Interior's Standards if the developer exercises its option. It is a Phase 1 option parcel to be held on a 99-year lease at an appraised rent; SF YIMBY's 2021 summary of the development-agreement filing described about 120 dwelling units in its shell (the Port's 2017 staff report assumed about 100 rental dwelling units), Brookfield's leasing page shows a Building 2 image captioned 'Creative office interior', and the Port's proposed 2026 amendments would have the developer assign its option and close escrow within six months of Board approval, with certain impact fees and special taxes waived. The Port's August 2026 report says construction of Phase 1 vertical projects 'has not moved forward'; no rehabilitation of Building 2 was found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: The outline is Assessor lot 4114009, so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a trace. The lot is Pier & Point's reading of the plan diagram and the satellite imagery (the lot lies beside Parcel D and Building 12, where the D4D's Historic Building box labelled 2 is drawn); no document read names it. The lot is the legal boundary, not the building's footprint. Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2) is an existing building (the D4D draws it as a Historic Building).
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4114009 (recorded 2020-10-23; mapped 2021-07-07; active); cross-checked against Pier 70 Design for Development Figure 6.4.2 - Building Height Maximum (p.155).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: No document names the Assessor lot of Building 2. Lot 4114009 (active) was assigned to it from Pier & Point's reading of the plan diagram, so its outline is that lot.
notes.regulatory_context: Officially 'Warehouse No. 2' per the D4D (Section 6.6.1), a historic industrial shop structure labelled 236 ft x 76 ft in the D4D's Figure 6.5.4 (the National Register registration form gives it as 256 ft long and 76 ft 9 in wide). Its use is not settled: the D4D treats it as a flexible parcel (Figure 2.1.1 stripes it Commercial-Office/Residential; the land-use scenarios in Figures 1.5.5-1.5.7 show it Residential in the Mid-Point baseline and Maximum Residential and Commercial-Office in Maximum Office), a 2021 development-agreement filing summarised about 120 dwelling units (SF YIMBY), and Brookfield's leasing page (pier70sf.com/leasing) shows 'creative office'. The NRHP gross area is 98,804 sq ft; a ~100,000 RSF brochure figure and a '~50,000 GSF, Arts/Maker' description formerly recorded here are uncited and have been dropped. No source read says whether rehabilitation has started. Port Item 11A (Aug 7, 2026, p.5) proposes that the developer assign its option on Building 2 and close escrow within 6 months of Board approval of the DDA amendments, and waive certain impact fees and special taxes for Building 2 'given the high costs of historic rehabilitation'; the text of the Port's June 2025 project update deck does not mention Building 2.

facts.value: Port of San Francisco; developer option under the DDA held by FC Pier 70, LLC (Brookfield Properties)
Six-story board-formed concrete warehouse, flat roof, 20 ft column grid, steel multi-pane sash; a bridge connects the fourth floor to the Building 12 mold loft
Flexible in the D4D (commercial-office or residential); sources differ on the current program (about 120 homes or creative office)
Secretary of the Interior's Standards for Rehabilitation (D4D S6.6.1)
99 years (option parcel), rent by appraisal accounting for historic rehabilitation costs and tax credits
Phase 1 (Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan, Exhibit A)
Warehouse for the Building 12 complex and outfitting; commercial storage at the time of the nomination
Market Square, entered through 'an existing passageway through Buildings 2 and 12' and a 21st Street opening between Building 2 and Parcel D (D4D §3.9)

open_questions: No appraisal, lease, permit or construction record for Building 2 was found; the Port's June 2025 deck does not mention it and the 2026 report says no Phase 1 option has been exercised.

Which program is current: the 2021 filing summary's ~120 dwelling units (SF YIMBY, Oct 27, 2021; tenure not stated), the Port's 2017 staff report's ~100 rental dwelling units, or the leasing page's 'Creative office interior' image. No source read says the apartment plan was put on hold.
The RSF figure (~100,000) on Brookfield's brochure, formerly noted in this record's map data, could not be verified; the NRHP gross area is 98,804 sq ft.
The 2026 memo's 'assign its option' language implies a third-party vertical developer for Building 2; none is named.

The D4D's Figure 6.6.1/6.6.2 page (p.160) was hosted here, but its three building photos are credited in the D4D to Forest City / Shae Rocco and SITELAB urban studio, private parties, so the image was removed; the D4D stays linked in Sources.
Dimensions of Building 2: the National Register (NRHP) nomination gives 256 ft long by 76 ft 9 in wide by 79 ft 6 in high; D4D Figure 6.5.4 gives 236 ft by 76 ft, 82 ft.
